summary: Write l = k·l' with l' ∈ K; then the reductions agree iff l' ∈ K(g), iff toPlaces(l') ∈ congGroup(F).

steps.claim: l = k·l' for some l' ∈ K;
reduction(k) = reduction(kl') iff l' ∈ ker = K(g) iff toPlaces(l') ∈ congGroup(F).
steps.lean: simpa [principalLevel, mem_latStabilizer_iff.1 l.2] using hF.mem_principalLevel_iff (x := l)
